name: Tower Heroes [UPD] 🎃
desc:
Use codes: SPOOKTACULAR, H24_VANESSA, and halloween2020 for freebies!

What's New?
- Halloween Event!
- Complete daily Contract challenges assigned by Deeds, Alvin, and Chomps to earn rewards!
- All previous Contracts and their Rewards return! (2023 and 2024 Halloween Events)
- New Contracts from Deeds with new rewards coming soon!
- 2022 Halloween Pass returns as a Gamepass! Collect candy corn drops from enemies to progress in the pass and earn rewards. The first 7 tiers are free!
- Halloween Content Returns! Hero, Maps, Crate, Sticker Pack, etc

- New Weekly Challenge!
- New Gimmick, Boss, and Skin Reward for the weekly!

Tower Heroes is a Tower Defense game with a variety of unique Heroes to add to your arsenal. Battle against various enemies across a variety of different maps, each with their own unique bosses! Fight against other players in PVP mode, or team together to take down bosses in Freeplay mode and Campaign mode. Plenty of skins, stickers, modifiers, and more to collect.
